_comment: Shared compiler settings for the workspace PACKAGES (contracts, db,
channels, jobs). They had four identical copies of this block, which is
exactly how strictness drifts apart one package at a time.
The two APPS deliberately do NOT extend it: apps/edge is NodeNext because
it ships as vanilla Node functions where import specifiers must carry a
.js suffix, and apps/dashboard is bundler-resolution because Next resolves
for it. That difference is meaningful, not drift.
